info.title: ASI Stage 06 Providers and Routing
info.description: Local owner API. Host and exact allowed Origin are validated; cookie-authenticated mutations require CSRF and durable idempotency. HEAD follows GET authentication. Credentialed OPTIONS preflight does not authorize operations. No public arbitrary inference or credential-read endpoint.

CreateProvider.description: Only official OpenAI or the exact operator-allowlisted compatible endpoint. secretReferenceId is recognized but rejected until a qualified provider reference store exists. Never send API keys in this body.

Discovery.description: probe:false performs bounded model discovery. probe:true requires a ceiling, then fails closed with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: HTTP lacks a project budget/grant binding. Project-scoped inference qualification uses the trusted provider:verify command.
